standings.note: Calculated from final regular-season scores as of retrieval; a week can be partly completed. Sorted by win percentage, point differential, then abbreviation; not official playoff seeding. rank intentionally null.

weeklyLeaders.note: Previous available week's yards; future selected weeks explicitly retain latest verified leader week.

roster.note: Current retained roster: active, reserve and practice squad; cut players excluded.

playerStats.note: Summed regular-season weekly statistics, gated to corroborated final games. Missing source row or numeric cell is unavailable, not assumed zero; missing required source columns reject refresh. games means games with a statistics row, not confirmed appearances or snaps. NFL passer rating calculated from verified attempts/completions/yards/TD/INT.

teamStats.note: Gross passing yards displayed separately; total yards uses passing minus sack yards plus rushing. Per-game denominators use only completed Steelers games with verified team-stat rows; scores without released statistics are excluded from these totals.

schedule.note: Kickoff converted from America/New_York with daylight saving. Fixture records are entering each week; future records reflect latest completed week, not predictions.

injuries.note: Practice participation and report status are separate. Blank report status is unavailable; absent player does not mean healthy. Confirmed game-day inactive list unavailable.

depthChart.note: Latest published ESPN-derived depth order, not a confirmed starter designation.

opponentAllowances.note: Opponent player-stat totals grouped by QB/RB/WR/TE; every position uses the same completed opponent games with verified offensive-stat coverage. New final scores do not dilute unreleased stat totals; absent position rows are unavailable.

historicalMatchups.note: Most recent five completed meetings; each game carries its original season/week.

historicalPrices.note: Archival moneylines preserved exactly. Bookmaker and capture time are not supplied by source; cannot identify exact previous pre-game price.

exactPreGamePrices.note: Archived dataset moneylines are available, but no bookmaker identity or capture time verifies an exact previous pre-game head-to-head price.

weatherForecast.note: No accessible verified forecast feed in this environment. NOAA API blocked403 during audit. Historical recorded conditions remain sourced game data.

travel.note: Team travel itinerary not publicly verified. Home/away, venue and rest days are available from the schedule.

crossChecks.note: Internal dataset consistency validated. Independent official/ESPN API retrieval blocked403; no claim of independently verified official standings.

sourcePolicy: Public authorised datasets only; rejected sources are not bypassed. Required-source failure retains the preceding verified snapshot.
refreshCadence: Recommend every six hours during the season; snapshot freshness is always visible in app.
